servicesIntro: A single page, a missed handoff or a broken reminder can be the whole job.

situations.title: Help people find and contact you
situations.symptom: Your opening hours differ across listings, or you have no single page to send a new client.
situations.deliverable: I can bring the service details together on one page and check each contact link.
situations.draft: Hi Aleks, I’d like people to find the right information about my business and know how to reach me. Here’s what they see today:

situations.title: Give each inquiry a next step
situations.symptom: A request comes in by email or WhatsApp. Later, someone has to ask again for the same detail.
situations.deliverable: I can set up a shared record showing what came in, what is missing and who follows up.
situations.draft: Hi Aleks, I’d like to improve how we handle incoming requests. Here’s how a typical request reaches us and where it gets held up:

situations.title: Existing Workflow Rescue
situations.symptom: A Google Sheet gives the wrong total, or an Apps Script reminder has stopped arriving.
situations.deliverable: I can trace the fault, fix the affected step and show you how to check the result.
situations.draft: Hi Aleks, a tool we already use needs a fix. Here’s the tool, what I expected it to do and what happened instead:

workIntro: I built these independent concepts for three service businesses in Quito. Each explores a different first conversation. The businesses did not commission them.

work.name: DBAC
work.method: Can someone tell which accounting service fits their question and what to ask the practice?

work.name: Nora Operaciones Inmobiliarias
work.method: Try approaching as a buyer, then as a seller. Each has a different reason for getting in touch.

work.name: LEGARTEP Asesoría Legal
work.method: Look for a relevant area of practice and the information you would share in a first inquiry.

methodSteps.title: Start with one real example
methodSteps.body: Send a link, a description or a screenshot with private details removed. We agree on the change and how to tell it worked.

methodSteps.title: Keep what already works
methodSteps.body: I trace the steps involved and make the smallest change that solves the problem in your day-to-day work.

methodSteps.title: Check it and hand it over
methodSteps.body: We try a representative example. You get the finished change and a short note on how to use and check it.

support: If things change later, we can agree on an update, a new check or occasional maintenance.
aboutBody: My name is Aleks Karpov. I work independently, combining experience in small business, administration and automation. I want solutions to help with real daily work: communicating with customers, finding information and meeting deadlines.
aboutQuote: Before suggesting a tool, I want to understand how your work is done and what would make it easier.
aboutFacts: I have worked in the day-to-day operations of four large companies and more than ten small businesses, and managed five small teams.
I have handled large volumes of information for more than 160 clients, keeping track of documents, deadlines and individual requirements.
I have built automations to organize data, send reminders and track deadlines.
